about: Pass 7 batch A (2026-10-09): the authors' own comparator measurements for the 27 openly licensed LLM sources in lone-batch-A.json (235 own-model results that were alone in their run). Candidate rows only; data/ was not edited. Every result reuses the source_id and the exact pinned URL of the own-model row it sits beside; no new ledger ids (scope notes for the owner are in ledger_scope_notes). 353 results (173 lab, 180 independent) and 3 comparison-only models (mimo-v2-flash, minimax-m2-1, olmo-3-7b-think-dpo; 18 of the rows use them). Merge: models first, then results via npm run import. Simulated on a scratch copy of the current repo (HEAD ada61d6c): import adds +3 models, +353 results with no skips, and node scripts/check.ts --validate-only passes. Lone runs that count (>=2 catalogue models in the source x benchmark run): 1/235 before, 115/235 after (109 without the proposed models). held_for_owner and gaps are NOT part of results.
